stage0031b_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$マコト$$
「The target's closing in directly overhead...
　It's drilling down toward the Geofront」

stage0031b_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$シゲル$$
「$c has forces deployed nearby, but
　wary of its long-range fire, they can't act」

stage0031b_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Can't be helped.
　Just keeping it in check to limit the Angel's
　movement, even a little, is enough for now」

stage0031b_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So its target is here... a direct strike
　on NERV HQ. Report each department's findings」

stage0031b_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$リツコ$$
「From the last battle's data, we infer the target
　auto-eliminates any hostile within a set range」

stage0031b_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So closing to melee range
　would take serious resolve.
　What about its A.T. Field?」

stage0031b_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Still intact.
　Its phase pattern keeps shifting too, so
　its shape won't stabilize, so neutralizing it is hard」

stage0031b_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Guess brute force is the only way through, huh...」

stage0031b_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$マコト$$
「MAGI's calculations say that piercing the target's
　A.T. Field with an N2 depth charge strike
　would need enough force to destroy NERV HQ itself」

stage0031b_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Matsushiro's MAGI-02 reached the same conclusion.
　The Federal Government's apparently pushing for
　a self-destruct strike on NERV HQ itself」

stage0031b_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ミサト$$
「They don't seem to get the situation.
　If we lose this place, it's all over...」

stage0031b_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「What's the Angel's ETA to NERV HQ?」

stage0031b_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$シゲル$$
「Estimated at 12:06:54 AM tomorrow...
　That's 10 hours, 14 minutes from now」

stage0031b_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$ survived, but Unit-01's wrecked...
　and $c can't even get close...」

stage0031b_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$マヤ$$
「We're boxed in on all sides, huh」

stage0031b_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$マコト$$
「Should we just raise the white flag?」

stage0031b_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Wait a second...
　There's $$メール$$ addressed to me」

stage0031b_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...There might still be something we can do」

stage0031b_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「With this plan and that equipment, maybe...」

stage0031b_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$冬月$$
「...You approved Lt. Col. Katsuragi's operation plan?」

stage0031b_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「There's no other way but that」

stage0031b_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$冬月$$
「It's based on that man's plan...
　Can he be trusted?」

stage0031b_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「No issue.
　He himself is already part of the plan」

stage0031b_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$冬月$$
「What do you intend to do about Unit-01's pilot?」

stage0031b_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「The Dummy Plug is still pre-trial.
　Until it's ready for use, the current pilot
　will have to keep serving his purpose」

stage0031b_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「If he fails, we simply use $$レイ#333$$」

stage0031b_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$冬月$$
「Put $$レイ#333$$ in Unit-01...?
　Isn't that far too dangerous?」

stage0031b_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Whatever means it takes, we must
　defeat the 8 remaining Angels」

stage0031b_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Ayanami... you've been here the whole time...?」

stage0031b_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「I'll relay the schedule for Operation Yashima,
　set to launch tomorrow at midnight」

stage0031b_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Pilots Ikari and Ayanami are to assemble
　at Terminal 2 today at 1930.
　After that, follow Lt. Col. Katsuragi's orders」

stage0031b_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「You're telling me to get in the EVA again...」

stage0031b_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't want to do this anymore...
　I don't want to feel that scared again...
　So scared, so scared... but I can't run away either...!」

stage0031b_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「You're scared of the EVA?
　Then just go to sleep」

stage0031b_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I hate it, getting in the EVA...
　When it goes well, it's just expected,
　so nobody ever praises me...）

stage0031b_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$シンジ$$
（If I fail, they'll hate me.
　If it's bad enough, I just die...
　Why am I even here...?）

stage0031b_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Meeting $$赤木$$ and everyone in the Volunteer Club,
　I thought something might change... that something
　good might happen, so I came here, but...）

stage0031b_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$シンジ$$
（But I don't want this anymore...
　I'm not here to suffer like this...）

stage0031b_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...$$シンジ$$, the assembly time's long past, you know?」

stage0031b_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Everyone in $c
　is in position with the resolve to die if needed.
　You do your job properly too」

stage0031b_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Then why not just have everyone
　handle the attack on the Angel...?」

stage0031b_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...I'm scared, of getting in the EVA」

stage0031b_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ミサト$$
「What are you saying, now of all times?」

stage0031b_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It's easy for you, $$ミサト$$...
　You just sit safe underground, giving orders,
　that's all...」

stage0031b_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm the only one who has to be scared...
　It's not fair, $$ミサト$$!」

stage0031b_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...Come with me for a sec」

stage0031b_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ミサト$$
「15 years ago, the world we came from
　lost half of humanity to $$セカンドインパクト$$」

stage0031b_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ミサト$$
「If the Angels trigger a Third Impact now,
　humanity will truly go extinct this time...
　every single one of us」

stage0031b_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I've heard that story, over and over」

stage0031b_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ミサト$$
「If we let an Angel breach NERV HQ's
　Level Triple-E, headquarters is set to
　automatically self-destruct」

stage0031b_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ミサト$$
「We'd trade blows with the Angel to stop
　a Third Impact... everyone here works with that resolve」

stage0031b_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I'll show you the proof of that too」

stage0031b_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「This is...! Don't tell me, an EVA!?」

stage0031b_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ミサト$$
「No.
　This is the Second Angel, $$リリス$$, both the origin
　of life on this planet and the key to its end」

stage0031b_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's right...
　It's said to be the trigger for a Third Impact too」

stage0031b_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Protecting this $$リリス$$, fighting with an EVA...
　that's something only you can do」

stage0031b_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Only me...?
　But everyone in $c is here too...」

stage0031b_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「The EVA was built to defeat the Angels...
　We're entrusting humanity's future to you
　and the EVA you pilot」

stage0031b_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Something that hard... why does it have to be me...」

stage0031b_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「There's no reason.
　That fate just happened to be yours」

stage0031b_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「But it's not just you, $$シンジ$$, risking
　your life to fight alone.
　We're all in this together」

stage0031b_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...Now, I'll relay each role for this operation.
　$$シンジ$$, you're on Unit-01 as gunner」

stage0031b_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$レイ#333$$, you're on Unit-00, handling defense」

stage0031b_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ミサト$$
「This operation calls for tighter precision.
　That's why Unit-01, with the most combat data,
　will serve as attacker」

stage0031b_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「The positron cannon to snipe the Angel is still
　a prototype, but it's already tuned for Unit-01」

stage0031b_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$シンジ$$
「From here, I snipe the Angel...」

stage0031b_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Listen, $$シンジ$$.
　Positrons curve under Earth's spin,
　magnetism, and gravity. Not straight」

stage0031b_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Don't forget to correct for that.
　Pierce straight through the core, and only the core」

stage0031b_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't even know where its core is!」

stage0031b_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ミサト$$
「It's alright.
　Part of it only turns solid while it's
　attacking. That's presumed to be the core」

stage0031b_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ミサト$$
「We'll handle all the targeting data
　and firing guidance from here.
　Just follow the script」

stage0031b_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Power's being drawn from all over Japan
　for the positron cannon, fed in by cable.
　So Unit-01 can't leave the firing position」

stage0031b_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But then, if the Angel attacks us...」

stage0031b_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's what $$レイ#333$$ is for.
　And Aquarion and $$ジェニオン$$
　will be your escort too」

stage0031b_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ミサト$$
「And on the front line, everyone from $c
　will keep them pinned down」

stage0031b_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$シンジ$$
「No way...!
　That puts everyone in danger!」

stage0031b_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Danger's the same for everyone.
　Us, $c, and everyone in the world...」

stage0031b_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ミサト$$
「It's alright, $$シンジ$$.
　Operation Yashima came to us from someone
　who knows $c well」

stage0031b_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「And combined with the positron cannon
　sniping I proposed, it's practically perfect」

stage0031b_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Alright, $$レイ#333$$... come here,
　I'll walk you through using the shield」

stage0031b_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「A stuffed toy...
　Why is something like this here...?」

stage0031b_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Sorry, right before the operation.
　Everyone asked me to give you a message」

stage0031b_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Yeah... Everyone's busy, so I was about
　the only one who could make it, but...」

stage0031b_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$タケル$$, $$竜馬$$, $$葵$$, $$桂$$,
　$n, and Miss $$スズネ$$ too...
　Everyone believes in you, $$シンジ$$」

stage0031b_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「This is a sniping cheat sheet from
　$$クルツ$$ and $$ミシェル$$, a charm from Ensign
　$$リディ$$, and lunch from $$甲児$$ and $$アルト$$...」

stage0031b_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Also... I've got letters from $$トウジ$$
　and $$ケンスケ$$, so read them later, okay?」

stage0031b_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I mean, so many people cheering you on,
　expecting things, believing in you...」

stage0031b_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$シンジ$$, you're... not like me...
　You always try so hard... even today...」

stage0031b_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That's not true.
　But... I can fight because
　everyone at $c is with me」

stage0031b_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It must be the same for you, $$ミコノ$$」

stage0031b_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$アマタ$$, $$カイエン$$, and everyone at Element,
　and everyone from $c too,
　will surely help you, $$ミコノ$$」

stage0031b_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So... let's fight together, $$ミコノ$$」

stage0031b_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「...Thanks, $$シンジ$$.
　I came here to cheer you up, but
　I'm the one who got cheered up...」

stage0031b_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Sorry for acting so full of myself...」

stage0031b_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「No, it's fine...
　You gave me courage, $$シンジ$$...」

stage0031b_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Thank you, $$シンジ$$.
　I believe in you too, you know」

stage0031b_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That might've been a first...
　encouraging someone else...」

stage0031b_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Maybe I've changed a little...
　riding the EVA, meeting so many people...」

stage0031b_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But... honestly, I'm still scared...
　When everyone says they believe in me,
　I feel happy and afraid, both at once...」

stage0031b_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「When I think it might not go well...」

stage0031b_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「...But still, they'd say they believe in you」

stage0031b_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「It's been a while, $$碇シンジ$$.
　Not since I asked you for directions」

stage0031b_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「So you know who I am now」

stage0031b_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I didn't notice it when we first met,
　but afterward I read an article
　about you on a news site」

stage0031b_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I heard the Black Knights' $$ゼロ$$ killed you,
　but you were alive after all」

stage0031b_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I wasn't even permitted to die」

stage0031b_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Before an important operation,
　I'll tell you just one thing」

stage0031b_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「$$碇シンジ$$... live for yourself.
　Not for your father, not for anyone」

stage0031b_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「That's all I wanted to say」

stage0031b_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I have my own preparations to make」

stage0031b_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ルルーシュ$$ vi Britannia is gone.
　What remains is the man who makes
　miracles happen... I am $$ゼロ$$」

stage0031b_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Don't worry.
　$c will hold the front line.
　You just focus on the shot」

stage0031b_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「The masked man, $$ゼロ$$...
　Just who is he, really...?」

stage0031b_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Unit-00's ready to go too, huh...」

stage0031b_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...Ayanami... why do you pilot the EVA?」

stage0031b_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「I don't have anything else, after all」

stage0031b_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Is it wise, the commander
　absent from the command center?」

stage0031b_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「The operation is already underway.
　My judgment isn't needed there」

stage0031b_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Or are you anxious about the very
　operation you proposed yourself?」

stage0031b_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Not a manner of speaking I care for」

stage0031b_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Even so, I am grateful for your help」

stage0031b_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Ready to talk about your plan now?」

stage0031b_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「How much do you already know?」

stage0031b_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Nor do I care for answering a question
　with a question」

stage0031b_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I never expected you to like me」

stage0031b_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then hear this.
　I reject what you're trying to do」

stage0031b_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「And your way of being a father, too」

stage0031b_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$冬月$$
「It seems he doesn't grasp the whole
　of the Human Instrumentality Project」

stage0031b_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Even so, he grasps its outline
　because he inherits the plan of this world」

stage0031b_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$冬月$$
「In every world, mankind must have
　acted before the sun could set...」

stage0031b_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「The same is true for us」

stage0031b_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$冬月$$
「But nothing can be done for that
　without defeating $$第６の使徒$$」

stage0031b_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「$c...
　They will fill what the plan lacks」

stage0031b_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Ayanami!
　Are you all right, Ayanami?!」

stage0031b_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Don't say you've got nothing else...
　don't say things like that...」

stage0031b_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Don't say something as sad as goodbye
　when we're about to part...」

stage0031b_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「...I'm sorry.
　I don't know what kind of face
　to make at a time like this...」

stage0031b_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$アルト$$
「You're gasping for air and still
　cracking puns?!」

stage0031b_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Maybe, even if I keep riding the EVA,
　I might never find anything good...）

stage0031b_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$シンジ$$
（But this is the world I'm going to live in...）

stage0031b_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$カヲル$$
「...I know.
　That boy has awakened,
　entered the convergence stage, hasn't he?」

stage0031b_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「Indeed.
　The Dead Sea Scrolls Apocrypha has moved
　to the Book of Law. The covenant nears...」

stage0031b_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
???
「Allow me to lend a hand with that as well.」

stage0031b_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$カヲル$$
「There's no need to be wary.
　He's the same as us.」

stage0031b_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$カヲル$$
「I understand how you feel.
　That feeling of 'this time for sure'...」

stage0031b_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$カヲル$$
（...but the Third Child again, huh.
　He never changes...）

stage0031b_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$カヲル$$
（I'm looking forward to meeting you,
　$$碇シンジ$$...）

stage0031b_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, $$アマタ$$!
　Wiping out the Abductors and the
　Mechanical Beasts in that close a call!」

stage0031b_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$シンジ$$ was working hard too.
　That's what pushed me on.」

stage0031b_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My my, they say chasing two rabbits
　catches you neither, but I could learn
　from that kind of greed.」

stage0031b_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With that attitude, $$アルト$$ could
　probably manage things better too...」

stage0031b_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You mean $$アルト$$'s two-timing someone?」

stage0031b_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since two charming women fancy him,
　a real man ought to just accept it
　wholeheartedly, wouldn't you say?」

stage0031b_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In fact, not making his stance clear
　means he's out to sink his fangs
　into both of them...」

stage0031b_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I don't think that's true, but...」

stage0031b_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, defending $$アルト$$ now?
　Then perhaps you're the same sort,
　$$アマタ$$?」

stage0031b_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, make your choice firmly
　when the time comes. Women want
　a man who's decisive.」

stage0031b_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thanks to your great efforts this time,
　we earned about 150 Z-Chips. I'll add
　them to the squad's stock.」

stage0031b_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good, so you're human after all.
　Even I can't speak Frog, so I
　wondered what I'd do.」

stage0031b_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies again.
　Cats in your world are defined
　differently than in others, aren't they.」

stage0031b_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let me properly introduce myself,
　$$ユノハ・スルール$$. I welcome you.」

stage0031b_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, yes, a smiling face suits
　you better after all. You're cute,
　$$ユノハ$$.」

stage0031b_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That won't do.
　At this rate, dating is a dream
　within a dream.」

stage0031b_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh dear, if mere words from someone
　like me do this, what would happen
　with a real, flesh and blood man...?」

stage0031b_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That said, since you're here,
　let's have you help mind the shop.
　Go on, then.」

stage0031b_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「T-today too, I'll give it my all...
　business, business!」
